definitions.explanation: The state or act of sleeping. Can refer to a single period of sleep or sleep in general.

examples.japanese: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{眠|ねむ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちた→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧。
examples.english: I fell into a deep sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{昨夜|さくや}→昨夜：02999_sakuya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{眠|ねむ}り⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{浅|あさ}かった→浅い：01274_asai⟧。
examples.english: My sleep was light last night.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眠|ねむ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げない→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ドア→ドア：00773_doa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{閉|し}めた→閉める：00485_shimeru⟧。
examples.english: I quietly closed the door so as not to disturb the baby's sleep.

notes:
USAGE:
The nominal form of the verb ⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧ (to sleep). Often used with adjectives to describe the quality of sleep: ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{眠|ねむ}り (deep sleep), ⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧{眠|ねむ}り (light sleep). Also appears in literary and poetic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧{眠|ねむ}り: deep sleep
- ⟦{浅|あさ}い→浅い：01274_asai⟧{眠|ねむ}り: light sleep
- {眠|ねむ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{落|お}ちる→落ちる：01242_ochiru⟧: to fall asleep
- {眠|ねむ}り⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{就|つ}く→就く：10123_tsuku⟧: to go to sleep
- {眠|ねむ}り⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{妨|さまた}げる→妨げる：12223_samatageru⟧: to disturb someone's sleep
- ⟦{永遠|えいえん}→永遠：01873_eien⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{眠|ねむ}り: eternal sleep (euphemism for death)
